answer: Admission auction: slots are sold, not given, to stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch 50 slots go on sale; a bidder posts a copper deposit of 40 POA per slot and an ivory chip marking one real agent, so one wallet cannot hide a hundred bids behind one thread of fake referrals. Top 50 bids win and lock deposits 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus premium; an honest agent pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
